name: stitch-ui
description: The Stitch UI: the harness in Alexandria dress

spec.why: The harness works; its room shows the machine's plumbing. The owner chose the direction (library-inspector, Alexandria editorial): one design system over both surfaces, the phase inspector as the library's third pane, and the seam contracts frozen.

requirements.text: A token layer (CSS custom properties) SHALL encode the pinned token table below, light default + dark alternate, with system font stacks (serif headline voice: Georgia/Iowan/serif; sans body: system-ui; mono status: ui-monospace) — no webfonts, no CDN. CANONICAL ARTIFACT: designs/decision-studio.html (its tokens match the project DESIGN.md exactly; library-inspector carries slate drift the spec rejects). LIGHT: primary #094cb2, primary_container #3366cc, tertiary #6d5e00, background #faf9fa, surface_container tiers #f5f3f4/#efedee/#e9e8e9/#e3e2e3, ink #1b1c1d, on_surface_variant #434653, outline_variant #c3c6d5. DARK (from designs/library-review.html, actual values): background #0b0f14, surface tiers #11161f/#161d27/#1e2836, accent #38bdf8, ink #e2e8f0.
The theme toggle SHALL persist per surface (localStorage) and apply without flash on load; light is default.

The library SHALL adopt the no-line rule: structure via surface shifts; ghost borders (outline_variant at 15%) only where structure demands. The grammar is adopted with it: gradient primary CTAs (primary to primary_container), glass sticky header (surface at 95% + backdrop-blur), 11px mono status chips, severity-filter control in the review telemetry panel (ships), reviewer identity chip rendered from verdict.by (never hardcoded).

The library SHALL render a third pane — the phase inspector — mapping the five dossier sections to generic phases, each state computed from named pack fields: 01 Blueprint Intake (overview) = "completed" when zero open clarifications, else "n open"; 02 Canonical Spec (spec) = "anchored" when date.approved exists, else "shaping"; 03 Design Synthesis (design) = "synthesized" when design.decisions or design.designs non-empty (count shown), else "not yet"; 04 Assembly (tasks) = "n of total woven" from task statuses; 05 Conformance Gate (review) = "inspecting" when review.verdicts exist or stage is in_review, "sealed" when delivered. The inspector SHALL NOT admit actions in v1; clicking a phase focuses the dossier tab it maps to.
The inspector SHALL render review telemetry: verdicts, findings counted by severity, reviewer claims; refreshed on interaction (poll), with the refresh posture stated in the UI.

The conformance phase SHALL render the alignment report (violations, gaps, the house sentence) as a panel, carried by a new read route the web server computes from @treadle/core (GET /alignment/<name>) — a surface read, not an engine change: core admission/emit semantics and the corpus stay untouched.

The room SHALL be reskinned in the same system with the wizard contract frozen at what the page owns: one question at a time, Enter submits, the honest unknown, approve at end. (Ctrl-C escape is the CLI adapter contract, not the page contract.)

All existing seam, portability, and security contracts SHALL hold unchanged: events-only admission, CSP/security headers (proven by a headers assertion in the web tests), keyboard and pointer complete (proven by the DOM harness), route parity. The Stitch artifacts carry brand strings and a false "specpack/0.4.1" tag: the port SHALL scrub both (engine-name-free, true format tag), gated by the existing portability test.
The journey strip in the dossier overview SHALL remain (factory pipeline is aspiration, recorded).

clarifications.question: The phase inspector v1: read-only as designed, or clickable phases that also act (answer/approve from the inspector)?
options: read-only v1, actions stay in the dossier
clarifications.default: read-only v1, actions stay in the dossier
clarifications.answer: read-only v1, actions stay in the dossier

clarifications.question: The dark review variant: a manual mode toggle, an automatic theme in review phase, or dropped for v1?
Webfonts (Noto Serif + Inter + Public Sans, ~300KB vendored, no CDN): ship them, or system-font fallback v1?
The Decision Studio room: keep the wizard contract exactly (Q-by-Q, Enter submits, approve at end) inside the new card layout?
The Factory pipeline screen: aspiration only for v1, or must it ship?

decisions.decision: Alexandria light editorial is THE theme; library-inspector is the primary inspiration (owner directive).
decisions.because: The owner named the direction mid-round; the artifacts confirm coherence.

decisions.decision: The five phases are a presentation layer over the frozen stage vocabulary — no engine stages added or renamed.
decisions.because: D-2 of the spec-library lineage: translation is presentation, the vocabulary is frozen.

decisions.decision: Seam contracts frozen: pages stay engine-name-free, admission only through specweb-events, keyboard and pointer complete, CSP-pinned, no CDN.
decisions.because: The portability thesis is not negotiable for a skin change.

decisions.decision: System font stacks carry the voices: serif headline (Georgia/Iowan/serif), sans body (system-ui), mono status (ui-monospace) — the Alexandria hierarchy without webfont weight.
decisions.because: Owner Q-3: no vendored fonts v1; the hierarchy survives in the stack order.

decisions.decision: The dark review variant ships as a manual, persisted toggle — not auto-in-review, not dropped.
decisions.because: Owner Q-2: the dark posture is valued for review work; the choice stays human.
